snippet.title: AmaTisMo - First Official Teaser
snippet.description:
► Audio Description Teaser (English): https://youtu.be/Fgxi-P3IcbY
---
Are you okay? Sometimes, no one asks.

AmaTisMo is an inclusive visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love, designed for everyone, including blind players, with full compatibility for screen readers.

---
LINKS

► Steam - Wishlist it now!
  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4707800/AmaTisMo/

► Free demo, alpha version (itch.io)
  https://vegetines.itch.io/amatismo

► Official website
  https://amatismo.es

► Newsletter (updates)
  https://amatismo.es/#newsletter

---
CREDITS

Original Soundtrack
  Michael Lückgen - https://www.michael-lueckgen.com/

Voice Acting (Amatista)
  Nova Merchante

Portuguese Subtitles (Portugal)
  Patrícia Mendes - https://www.linkedin.com/in/patriciamendes-pt/

---
VISUAL DESCRIPTION
(For blind users)

0:01 - The video opens with a white-line animation on a black background. A female silhouette (Amatista) is seen kneeling, holding her head in a moment of acute anxiety.

0:11 - We see Amatista in a dull-toned bathroom. She stands in front of a circular mirror, but she cannot see her reflection.

0:20 - A sequence of empty environments begins: a messy bedroom, an empty street, a long university hallway, and an empty classroom.

0:27 - A trembling hand holds a yellow note. Written on it are the words: "Are you okay?".

0:30 - The screen fades to black as the final plea is heard.

0:37 - The text appears: AmaTisMo. Wishlist it now on Steam.
